RIP HAYDEN🕊️
🎥🎬: I Love You, Beth Cooper (2009)

On the night of his high-school graduation, Denis Cooverman finally decides to confess his feelings to Beth Cooper, the most popular girl in school. To his surprise, Beth shows up at his house after his speech, turning what should have been an ordinary graduation night into an unexpected adventure.

Denis, his best friend Rich, and Beth spend the night getting caught up in a series of wild situations involving parties, jealous boyfriends, embarrassing secrets, and a desperate attempt to escape trouble. As the night unfolds, Denis discovers that Beth is very different from the perfect image he had created of her.

By the end of their chaotic night, Denis realizes that love, friendship, and growing up aren’t always as simple as they seem.

source_details.title: I Love You, Beth Cooper
source_details.synopsis: I Love You, Beth Cooper is a 2009 American teen romantic comedy film directed by Chris Columbus and starring Hayden Panettiere and Paul Rust. It is based on the novel by Larry Doyle, with Doyle also writing the film's screenplay. I Love You, Beth Cooper was released by 20th Century Fox on July 10, 2009. The film was panned for its acting, humor, and Columbus' direction, and underperformed at the box office, grossing $16.4 million against an $18 million budget.
